verses.ar:
أَيُّهَا الْمُشْتَاقُ لَا تَنَمِ ۞ هَذِهِ أَنْوَارُ ذِي سَلَمِ
عَنْ قَرِيبٍ أَنْتَ فِي الْحَرَمِ ۞ عِنْدَ خَيْرِ الْعُرْبِ وَالْعَجَمِ
verses.tr:
Ayyuha-l-mushtāqu lā tanami ۞ hādhihi anwāru Dhī Salami
ʿAn qarībin anta fi-l-ḥarami ۞ ʿinda khayri-l-ʿurbi wa-l-ʿajami
verses.en: O yearning lover, do not sleep — these are the lights of the valley of Salam; soon you will stand within the sanctuary, before the best of Arabs and non-Arabs.

verses.ar:
قِفْ أَمَامَ الْقَبْرِ فِي أَدَبِ ۞ مَا ثَلَا فِي أَشْرَفِ الرُّتَبِ
فِي مَكَانِ الْقُرْبِ وَالْقُرَبِ ۞ وَالرِّضَا وَالْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr:
Qif amāma-l-qabri fī adabi ۞ mā thalā fī ashrafi-r-rutabi
Fī makāni-l-qurbi wa-l-qurabi ۞ wa-r-riḍā wa-l-jūdi wa-l-karami
verses.en: Stand before the grave in reverence, before one whose rank none has ever equalled — in a place of nearness upon nearness, of contentment, generosity, and noble bounty.

verses.ar:
ثُمَّ قُلْ يَا أَشْرَفَ الرُّسُلِ ۞ يَا حَبِيبَ اللّٰهِ فِي الْأَمَلِ
يَا عَظِيمَ الْعِلْمِ وَالْعَمَلِ ۞ يَا سَمِيرَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ
verses.tr:
Thumma qul yā ashrafa-r-rusuli ۞ yā ḥabība-llāhi fi-l-amali
Yā ʿaẓīma-l-ʿilmi wa-l-ʿamali ۞ yā samīra-l-lawḥi wa-l-qalami
verses.en: Then say: O most honoured of messengers, O beloved of Allah in whom all hope rests; O magnificent in knowledge and deed, O companion of the Tablet and the Pen.

verses.ar:
لَيْسَ كَالْمُخْتَارِ فِي الْبَشَرِ ۞ فَهُوَ مِلْءُ السَّمْعِ وَالْبَصَرِ
وَاحِدُ التَّارِيخِ وَالسِّيَرِ ۞ وَإِمَامُ الرُّسُلِ وَالْأُمَمِ
verses.tr:
Laysa ka-l-Mukhtāri fi-l-bashari ۞ fa-huwa mil'u-s-samʿi wa-l-baṣari
Wāḥidu-t-tārīkhi wa-s-siyari ۞ wa imāmu-r-rusuli wa-l-umami
verses.en: None among humankind compares to the Chosen One — he fills all hearing and sight; unique in history and in the story of his life, leader of every messenger and every nation.

verses.ar:
لَيْلَةُ الْإِسْرَاءِ يَرْعَاهُ ۞ وَعَلَى الْمِعْرَاجِ مَرْقَاهُ
حَتَّى أَدْنَاهُ وَنَاجَاهُ ۞ بِكَلَامٍ لَيْسَ كَالْكَلِمِ
verses.tr:
Laylatu-l-isrā'i yarʿāhu ۞ wa ʿalā-l-miʿrāji marqāhu
Ḥattā adnāhu wa nājāhu ۞ bi-kalāmin laysa ka-l-kalimi
verses.en: The Night Journey watches over him, and upon the Ascension is his rank of nearness — until He drew him close and spoke with him, in words unlike any other words.

verses.ar:
رُتْبَةٌ مَا بَعْدَهَا شَرَفٌ ۞ دُونَهَا كُلُّ الْوَرَى وَقَفُوا
قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ لَهَا طَرَفٌ ۞ ثُمَّ أَوْ أَدْنَى إِلَى الْقِمَمِ
verses.tr:
Rutbatun mā baʿdahā sharafun ۞ dūnahā kullu-l-warā waqafū
Qāba qawsayni lahā ṭarafun ۞ thumma aw adnā ila-l-qimami
verses.en: A rank beyond which there is no higher honour, before which the whole of creation has come to a halt — one end of it at two bow-lengths, or nearer still, to the very summit of nearness.
